elastic_refresh_observation: The adapter indexes without an explicit refresh and Elastic is near-real-time, so the live test now polls for visibility. The contract promises at-least-once indexing, never same-millisecond visibility, so this is a test-accuracy fix, not a product defect; recorded here so nobody later reads the first failure as a broken adapter.
